June, I couldn't set up the recurring "Pod end of day" post. The gateway scheduler rejected both the list and the add with a credentials error: it needs a gateway auth token or pairing on this host before it will accept scheduled jobs. I haven't posted anything to #strategic-pod, and I can't confirm whether a job already exists, because the scheduler wouldn't list them either.

Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the auth config (`/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`) and then ask me again. Once the scheduler works, I'll create the job for 17:30 America/Chicago on weekdays, starting today, 2026-10-14. It will read only #strategic-pod and post the summary there.
